svg.title: Spotter features
svg.desc: What is new, at a glance: Old and new version side by side, grouped by day. See how often things ship: A cadence card per product, from its own release history. Start from a preset: Popular software is ready-made; add your own sources too. Latest against installed: The release list, what changed and where to download it.
svg.text: Stop checking for updates. Let them find you.
